item.title: Why We’re Obsessed With Black ’90s Love
item.description: In an era of situationships and soft-launch culture, Black ’90s sitcom love is trending again, and Gen Z can’t get enough. From bold declarations in Martin to the steady partnership in The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air, these relationships feel intentional in a way modern dating often doesn’t. But are we really nostalgic for the ’90s, or are we just craving clarity, security, and love that isn’t afraid to be seen? <p>The post Why We’re Obsessed With Black ’90s Love first appeared on Her Campus.</p>
